The great window and its tracery.
The portal, stone by stone.
Openings and houses.
A church front, a house, a tower.
A chimney, a tiled facade, a wooden balcony.
And more buildings, more details.
A palace front.
A triumphal arch.
A bridge.
The porticoes.
The concrete canopy hanging between them.
People underneath, for scale.
The main buildings around the courtyard.
The outbuildings, the paths, the trees and the pool.

Another, set in the landscape.
The dwelling: two tall volumes.
Terraces, a deck and the garden.
The walls and the planting along the plot.
The first houses, at the foot of the slope.
The row steps up the hill.
Trees and the ground around it.

The valley floor: the road, the trees, the gardens.

Terraces, paths and buildings on the slope.
The village on the rocks.
The terraces below, curving along the hill.

The terrace: the lawn, a figure at the rail, the pool.

Palms, and the life of the plaza.
People walking in the foreground.
First, the rocks.
Fewer rocks, set apart.
The rocks again.
A tree grows among them.
Then the city: the existing towers.
One of them, traced in green.
The existing towers around the site.
A green tower twisting among them.
The guest buildings and the pool.
More pavilions along the shore.
Dunes, palms and the sea.
Guest buildings around a pool.
A second arrangement.
The building, under one long gabled roof.
Pines all around, and the avenue in front.
A chalet with carved eaves.
A half-timbered house.
Steep pointed gables.
And a simple timber house.
